Class OmieServiceDetail

NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient.dll

The full registration of a service (ConsultarCadastroServico). The listing does not carry these fields and including a service order requires them on every item: LC 116 service code, municipal service code and tax classification. None of them can be invented — when they are missing from the Omie registration, the caller should stop and say which service to fix.
